title: Freezing a card, and the payments it does not stop
variant: A phone flow: six moments, each one tap apart
prompt: Wireframe the flow for freezing a lost bank card on mobile. The problem we keep hearing about is that people think a freeze stops everything, and it doesn't.
note: The sequence axis at its most literal: six phone frames, 390x844, one tap between each. It was chosen as the cover because the tall narrow frames make the grid read instantly as a flow rather than as a gallery, and because the argument lives in a single frame (3) that the caption names as such, which is the shape this template wants. The kit here is cut down to what a phone needs -- no window, no browser, no sidebar -- which is the deletion rule in practice. Frame 6 is a different size on purpose, to show that a file may mix them. Every merchant, amount and date is invented, and the reading notes say so rather than letting a plausible-looking $18.99 pass as research.
